fact: The 2024 activity report lists law 2018-026 of 7 December 2018 on cybersecurity and the fight against cybercrime, as amended by law 2022-009 of 24 June 2022, as the legal framework, and records 738 cybercrime cases for 2024 from police, gendarmerie and CERT.tg data.
title: ANCy - Rapport d'activités 2024
